items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: That's the only boy I could play. I tried him there in lunches out with Jack Carey. And I tried him out. He's the only one who could play that piece.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. That's the only boy I could play. I tried him there in lunches out with Jack Carey. And I tried him out. He's the only one who could play that piece.
But they played afterwards. They learned later. They learned later afterwards, yeah. I like Kinklitz and I like what's his name, Minstrel Man. Minstrel Man, yeah.
